name: @kiwa-test/qwikcity
description: Qwik City routeAction$ + routeLoader$ + Endpoints test adapter for kiwa — invoke action / loader / onGet|onPost handlers with simulated RequestEvent and capture JSON / redirect / status without a running Qwik dev server (part of the kiwa test framework family)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/invoke-route-action.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/invoke-route-loader.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/invoke-endpoint.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/index.js'
